claim_zh: 分别展示当前样本情感极性及强度预测相对于训练均值参考的模态贡献、局部归因与媒体对应。

panels.b-d: target-specific top three visual word anchors
panels.e: all valid local signed attributions including unmapped punctuation and special tokens

data_mapping.heatmap: NPZ signed dimension sums, word slot weights
data_mapping.time: WhisperX alignment; not recovered feature windows

integrity: all valid slots retained; only exactly zero padding omitted; unread truncated words have no attribution
image_policy: original frames without crop/enhancement; supplemental frames retain provenance
statistics: one individual sample, no aggregate uncertainty
panel_label_qa: Explicit user request: hide a-f letters; retain strict 1.5 pt panel geometry checks.
